page_title: SAS 2-0 ACM | Sassuolo v AC Milan 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) picked up a yellow card from referee.
90+4' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) obviously dived.
90+3' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) puts a poor free kick into the box that Stefano Turati easily collects.
90+2' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Fabio Maresca interrupted the game to signal a free kick. AC Milan have a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' What was Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
88' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
86' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
84' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Armand Lauriente is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
84' A substitution has been made. M'Bala Nzola is replaced by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo).
81' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
80' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
77' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
77' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) went to the ground quite willingly.
71' Fabio Maresca shows the yellow card to Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) for a heavy challenge.
70' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
67' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Fabio Maresca signals a set piece.
66' It will be a substitution. Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Ardon Jashari walks off.
62' Wasted effort! Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
59' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Cristian Volpato.
59' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Youssouf Fofana and he is replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
59' Rafael Leao comes off the pitch to be replaced by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).
59' A substitution has been made. Alexis Saelemaekers goes off and Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) comes on.
57' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
57' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
55' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
51' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
49' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
49' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

47' 2 - 0 2:0. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a great first-timer into the bottom left corner. What an amazing finish! Mike Maignan did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Kristian Thorstvedt provided the assistance.
46' Half-time substitution. Nemanja Matic is replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
46' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) comes on the pitch for Christopher Nkunku.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Fabio Maresca has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' What a great effort! Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
40' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) is substituted due to injury. Fabio Grosso gives a chance to Woyo Coulibaly.
38' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Fabio Maresca didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
36' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
35' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
32' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is caught offside!
31' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

31' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
26' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
24' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
23' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
17' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
16' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
13' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
11' A cross from a corner kick by AC Milan is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
10' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
9' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
9' A yellow card for a tackle by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan). Fabio Maresca doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

7' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan was alert and the score remained the same.

5' 1 - 0 Goal! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. Armand Lauriente assisted in the goal. 1:0.
2' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
